items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A composable month calendar for any dated records, with navigation, selection, status counts and day details.
items.docs: Calendar accepts plain records and needs no Working List or data provider. Compose CalendarNavigation, CalendarGrid and CalendarDayRecords inside it. For remote data, useCalendarState exposes the visible date range and CalendarProvider connects the state to your results. Dates use the selected calendar, which defaults to Gregorian.

items.description: Composable, controlled Capture-style context selector primitives for React 18 DHIS2 applications.

items.title: DHIS2 Value Display

items.name: dhis2-value-types
items.title: DHIS2 Value Types

items.name: observation-cards
items.title: DHIS2 Observation Cards
items.description: Composable cards for one person's measurements over time and last recorded values, coloured by DHIS2 legend sets.
items.docs: Wrap the cards in ObservationsProvider with a trackedEntity and a program; it loads the program's metadata and the person's events once for every card inside. Render one ObservationCard per data element uid, with an optional unit, label and staleAfterDays. Without children a card picks its arrangement from the value type: numbers show the latest value, its legend, the change since the previous reading and a sparkline; other types show the last recorded value, and yes or no values and option sets say when it last changed. To compose a different card, place the parts ObservationLabel, ObservationLegend, ObservationValue, ObservationChange, ObservationSparkline and ObservationRecorded inside it. The card shows the loading, error and never recorded states itself, and the recorded date can be placed but never dropped. Use useObservation for custom layouts. See the observation cards docs page for examples.

items.name: program-rules
items.title: Program Rules
items.description: DHIS2 program rules through the official rule engine: effects for one event or many, with attribution and dependency tracking.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Navigation with expandable groups, footer actions and a collapsible sidebar.
items.docs: Use SidebarLink with render={<NavLink to="/projects" />} to highlight the current page. Add SidebarGroup for nested links and SidebarButton for footer actions. Use SidebarToggle in the sidebar or useSidebar() for a page-toolbar control. Give each sidebar its own SidebarProvider and SidebarNavigation. Collapsing preserves expanded groups and the selected page.

items.name: spreadsheet
items.title: Spreadsheet
items.description: DHIS2-typed grid entry: typed cells, Excel-style keys, paste and undo, and the state of each cell, for any data the app saves.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A read-only timeline that groups entries by day in the system calendar, with a now marker, an overdue group, show more and notices, plus DHIS2 tracker hooks and entry parts for a person's history across programs.
items.docs: Pass entries and a status to Timeline, then compose TimelineFeed, TimelineLoading, TimelineError, TimelineNotices, TimelineEmpty and TimelineShowMore inside it; useShowMore reveals past entries a step at a time. The timeline never fetches: filter, merge or replace the array before it reaches it. For tracker data, import from @/components/timeline/dhis2: useTrackedEntityHistory({ trackedEntity, timeField }) returns entries, status, notices and refetch for every program the person is enrolled in (or programs you pass). Render each entry with TimelineHistoryEntry, or compose TimelineEventEntry and its parts; add host actions with eventActions and useTimelineEventEntry(). Invalidate timelineKeys.root to refresh after edits elsewhere. Delete the dhis2 folder if you only need the generic layout.

items.name: tracked-entity-finder
items.title: DHIS2 Tracked Entity Finder
items.description: Composable parts and hooks to find one tracked entity within a program's search rules.
items.docs: Wrap the finder in FinderProvider with a program and an onSelect callback. Inside it compose a FinderForm containing FinderField (exact value) and FinderRangeField (number or date range) inputs, one per program attribute uid, plus an optional FinderHint and a FinderSubmit button. Show matches with FinderResults, which holds the state parts FinderSearching, FinderEmpty, FinderTooMany and FinderError, a FinderList of FinderItem rows with FinderValue cells, and FinderPagination. The program's search rules are enforced inside and cannot be loosened by props. Use the useFinder* hooks for custom layouts. See the tracked entity finder docs page for examples.

items.name: working-list
items.title: DHIS2 Working List
items.description: A composable React 18 Working List block for DHIS2 tracker programs.
items.docs: Render WorkingList beneath the DHIS2 app-runtime and TanStack Query providers. Compose WorkingListViewSwitcher, WorkingListToolbar with its column/filter/action controls, and WorkingListTable. View selection and pagination work uncontrolled by default or as independent controlled value/callback pairs. For a calendar view, install calendar alongside working-list and follow the tested composition at /blocks/working-list#calendar-view: useWorkingListDateBounds and useWorkingListDateRange supply the date window, and getWorkingListRecordStatus resolves tracker statuses without depending on Calendar. There is no separate working-list-calendar block.
